claims: The No. 4 seed Nebraska Cornhuskers advanced to their first-ever NCAA Tournament Sweet 16.
Nebraska Cornhuskers defeated No. 5 Vanderbilt 74-72 on March 21, 2026, in Oklahoma City.
Braden Frager hit the winning layup with 2.2 seconds left.
Nebraska Cornhuskers [are headed] to Houston for a Sweet 16 matchup on Thursday, March 26 against the winner of Florida/Iowa.
